note: Adapted from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989 (Fauna of India: Isoptera); the original is in English, and the material follows Akhtar 1974. There are sections for the alate and the soldier; the worker is not recorded in the original. The pseudoworker paragraph that immediately follows in the source package belongs to the next species, Cryptotermes perforans, and was not used. OCR problem: 'GeQgth' for the ocellus and 'O^Qgth' for the pronotum are garbled forms of 'length' and have been read as such from context.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and pronotum pale reddish brown; anteclypeus yellowish white; labrum yellowish brown; antennae yellowish brown. Head sparsely hairy; the margins of the pronotum and the body with a few bristles and short hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, sides almost parallel; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 0.95—0.97 mm, head width 1.00—1.01 mm; posterior margin weakly convex; Y-shaped suture not distinct. Compound eyes slightly projecting, elongate-oval (maximum diameter 0.33—0.36 mm). Ocelli oval (length 0.13—0.15 mm, width 0.09—0.11 mm), almost touching the compound eyes. Labrum wider than long, the sides converging posteriorly, the anterolateral angles rounded and projecting, the anterior margin weakly convex. Mandibles as in the genus. Antennae with segments 2 and 3 almost equal, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Pronotum subrectangular (length 0.59 mm, width 0.98—1.01 mm), almost as wide as the head; anterior margin shallowly concave; sides convex; posterior margin weakly concave in the middle. Tibial spurs 3:3:3; tarsus 4-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head dark brown, deepening anteriorly, almost black near the frontal ridges; labrum yellowish brown, mandibles dark reddish brown; pronotum yellowish brown, slightly darker anteriorly; legs yellowish brown; abdominal tergites pale brown. Head sparsely hairy; the margins of the pronotum and the body with bristles and short hairs. Head capsule short, subrectangular, strongly phragmotic, almost as long as wide; head length (to the base of the mandibles) 1.19—1.31 mm, head width 1.26—1.38 mm; Y-shaped suture weak; frontal ridges prominent, notched in the middle, slightly upturned and overlapping the vertex; vertex strongly concave behind the frontal ridges; both lateral tubercles prominent, the lower tubercle slightly longer than the upper. Compound eyes translucent, 0.11—0.15 mm long, 0.04—0.09 mm wide. Mandibles short, with a distinct basal swelling, the teeth reduced. Labrum ligulate, sides almost parallel, converging to a rounded obtuse apex. Antennae 10—13-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Pronotum subrectangular (length 0.61—0.74 mm, width 1.23—1.44 mm), slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin deeply concave; anterolateral angles smooth and rounded; sides rounded; posterior margin not distinctly concave in the middle.
